how_it_works_sequence: Name an account administrator and provide company details.
Supply company background, for example by scanning the company website.
Choose the agent's business role, name, and voice.
Optionally connect the agent to a collaborative application.

Set up a company email address for the agent and authorize access.
Invite staff to chat and message the agent through the dashboard.
Link a switchboard extension to the agent's phone.
Introduce the configured agent and let it begin work.
